**Subject:** Starting from May 8, Our Print Shop Accepts Recycled Paper

**Dear Artists and Designers,**

We're excited to announce a new initiative at our print shop: starting from May 8, we will be accepting recycled paper. This shift not only supports our commitment to sustainability but also ensures we're creating high-quality prints with eco-friendly materials.

We invite all artists to bring a sample of recycled paper to our shop. This will help us understand the quality and ensure that all our print jobs are done on the best materials. Your feedback is invaluable in making our process even more sustainable.

Thank you for your support and collaboration in creating a better future. Stay tuned for more updates from our team.

**Best regards,**
[Your Name]  
Founder, Your Print Shop
